## Description

What changed and why.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation

## Checklist

- [ ] I added or updated tests for this change

- [ ] `npm test` passes locally
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes locally
- [ ] No em-dashes or en-dashes were introduced in user-facing copy
